previous_statement: 2.1.2: Under x^μ→x^μ+ξ^μ with ξ^0=T, ξ^i=∂^iL+L^i_T (∂_iL^i_T=0): φ→φ-Ṫ, B→B+T-L̇, E→E-L, ψ→ψ, S_i→S_i-L̇^T_i, F_i→F_i-L^T_i. [Substitute h_{μν}→h_{μν}-∂_μξ_ν-∂_νξ_μ and decompose]
new_statement: 2.1.2: Under x^μ→x^μ+ξ^μ with ξ^0=T, ξ^i=∂^iL+L^i_T (∂_iL^i_T=0), the gauge transformation h_{μν}→h_{μν}+∂_μξ_ν+∂_νξ_μ (Wald convention, eq.4.4.9) gives: φ→φ-Ṫ, B→B+T-L̇, E→E-L, ψ→ψ, S_i→S_i-L̇^T_i, F_i→F_i-L^T_i. [Here ξ_0=η_{00}ξ^0=-T with (-,+,+,+), so ∂_0ξ_0=-Ṫ and h_{00}→h_{00}+2∂_0ξ_0=2φ-2Ṫ, giving φ→φ-Ṫ.]
